objective: Maximize exact-token prefill and sustained aggregate decode throughput for the full GLM-5.2 MXFP8/NVFP4/NF3 hybrid on four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs without losing stock-v20 accuracy, behavior, context capacity, or stability.

baseline.profile: user-supplied v20 hybrid service: TP4/DCP4/MTP3, seq8, graph32, batch3072, max length479744, GMU0.978, forced full-CKV gather, NVFP4 MLA KV, fastsafetensors, and 120KB/84KB PCIe all-reduce thresholds

candidate_selection.primary_score: geometric mean of candidate/baseline ratios over exact prefill 8K/64K/128K/240K/400K and sustained decode 0K C1/C2/C4/C8, 32K C1/C2/C4/C8, 128K C1/C2, and 300K C1 wherever both profiles have capacity
candidate_selection.repeat_rule: Repeat any decisive cell inside the 3% equivalence band or any apparent regression below it before selection.
tie_breakers: higher verified context and KV headroom
candidate_selection.eligibility: Balanced production candidates must pass all quality, tool, context, and stability gates and retain the user-supplied profile's 479744-token model limit. A lower-capacity topology may only be reported as a specialized non-production Pareto profile.

lavd_test.rule: Candidate exact count and exact-plus-near count must each be at least the freshly measured stock baseline; fail count must be no greater; zero request errors and zero max-token truncations. Repeat both profiles if one outcome separates them by only one run.

gsm8k.rule: Candidate accuracy must be at least the matched stock baseline with zero request errors; retain paired flip and exact McNemar evidence.

capacity_and_stability_gates.notes: Startup KV capacity is not sufficient evidence; the exact long-prefill/decode request must execute without CUDA OOM, Xid, engine death, or health loss.

decode.capacity_limited_cells: reported but excluded unless both baseline and candidate can run them
